changelog:
## Meet Gori
- Find Gori next to your balance, in Reports, during setup, and on other screens where he can help.

## Stay on top of transactions
- The bell shows how many detected transactions need approval.
- Igira sends a daily reminder while transactions are waiting for review. You can turn reminders off in Notifications.

## Easier to read
- Improved icon contrast in Dark mode.
- Available updates open a release-notes popup with a download button.
